headline: Bitcoin drops 5% to six-month low of $55,830 amid global financial market rout
summary: Bitcoin and Ether dropped to six-month lows as risk aversion hit digital asset markets. Bitcoin fell over 5% to $55,830 during the broader selloff in equities.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization. Its price trends heavily influence liquidity and sentiment across digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin dropped over 5% to touch a six-month low at $55,830.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A broad selloff across Wall Street equities spurred risk reduction across global cryptocurrency markets.
